name: Jonodut
seoTitle: Jonodut: Bangla and English websites for leaders
summary: A website in Bangla and English for a leader's promises, work and contact details, with a badge that shows exactly what was verified.
tagline: The one place voters can trust is really you. Run your public website from your phone, in Bangla and English, with identity verification visitors can read.

features.title: A public record you control
features.lead: One workspace for every website you run. Drafts stay private until you publish.

items.title: Bangla and English
items.body: Write each section once in both languages and preview the draft before anyone sees it.

items.title: Many websites, one sign-in
items.body: An office site, a constituency update page and a volunteer drive, each with its own address.

items.title: Publish when you are ready
items.body: Edits stay in draft. Preview privately, then publish in one step.

items.title: Verification visitors can read
items.body: A badge says exactly what Jonodut checked. It is never a government endorsement.

items.title: Built for a team
items.body: Give helpers the access they need, and keep sensitive actions, such as downloading supporter lists, behind their own permission.

items.title: Made for phones
items.body: The workspace works from a phone, with the menu moving to the bottom on small screens.

strip.label: Includes
strip.text: Websites · Bangla and English · Verification badge · Team access · Custom domains · Volunteer and event sign-ups

note.label: Web service
note.title: Your identity documents stay private
note.body: Jonodut keeps ID documents in private, encrypted storage that never appears on a website, in an email or in a download. Reviewers open them only to decide, and every view is recorded.

privacy.headline: ID documents stay private, and we use no advertising trackers.
privacy.lead: Jonodut keeps the account, verification and billing details it needs to run a leader's workspace. ID documents are held in private, encrypted storage and deleted 90 days after the final decision.

studioProof.hard: Many tenant websites served from one application, with private draft previews, audited publishing and verified custom domains.
